### GET /api/v1/calendar-feeds

List calendar feeds

The caller's own feeds (with their tokens), plus — for anyone holding `calendarFeed:manageAny` (owner/admin) — a token-less roster of every feed in the workspace so they can see who created what and revoke if needed.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organizationId` | string | yes |  |

**Responses**

- `200` — The caller's feeds and (for managers) the workspace roster
  - `CalendarFeedList`
    - `subscriptions`: array of `CalendarFeed`, required
      - `id`: string, required
      - `name`: string | null, required
      - `token`: string, required — The feed's URL secret — only ever returned to its owner
      - `statuses`: array of string, required
      - `lastAccessedAt`: string | null, required — ISO 8601.
      - `createdAt`: string, required — ISO 8601.
    - `canManageAll`: boolean, required — Whether the caller holds `calendarFeed:manageAny` — i.e. may see the roster below and revoke a teammate's feed
    - `allSubscriptions`: array of `WorkspaceCalendarFeed`, required — Roster of every feed in the workspace (token-less); empty unless `canManageAll`
      - `id`: string, required
      - `name`: string | null, required
      - `statuses`: array of string, required
      - `lastAccessedAt`: string | null, required — ISO 8601.
      - `createdAt`: string, required — ISO 8601.
      - `ownerId`: string, required
      - `ownerName`: string | null, required
      - `ownerEmail`: string, required
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`

### POST /api/v1/calendar-feeds

Create a calendar feed

Any member can create feeds for themselves. The response includes the feed's token (its URL secret).

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `CreateCalendarFeedBody`
  - `organizationId`: string, required
  - `name`: string (max length 100, default "")
  - `statuses`: array of one of `"scheduled"` | `"published"` | `"draft"` | `"pending_approval"` | `"failed"` (default []) — Statuses the feed surfaces. An unknown status is rejected rather than dropped; an empty list means the default view (scheduled + published).

**Responses**

- `200` — The feed was created
  - `CalendarFeedMutationResult`
    - `ok`: literal `true`, required
    - `subscription`: `CalendarFeed`, required
      - `id`: string, required
      - `name`: string | null, required
      - `token`: string, required — The feed's URL secret — only ever returned to its owner
      - `statuses`: array of string, required
      - `lastAccessedAt`: string | null, required — ISO 8601.
      - `createdAt`: string, required — ISO 8601.
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`

### PATCH /api/v1/calendar-feeds/{feedId}

Update one of your calendar feeds

Partial update scoped to the caller's own feeds — an omitted field is left unchanged. Deliberately not widened by `calendarFeed:manageAny`: revoking a teammate's feed is a security action, rewriting their private calendar view is not.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `feedId` | string | yes |  |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `UpdateCalendarFeedBody`
  - `organizationId`: string, required
  - `name`: string (max length 100) — The feed's label. Omit to leave it unchanged; send "" to clear it.
  - `statuses`: array of one of `"scheduled"` | `"published"` | `"draft"` | `"pending_approval"` | `"failed"` — Statuses the feed surfaces. Omit to leave the current filter unchanged; an empty list means the default view (scheduled + published). An unknown status is rejected rather than dropped.

**Responses**

- `200` — The updated feed
  - `CalendarFeedMutationResult`
    - `ok`: literal `true`, required
    - `subscription`: `CalendarFeed`, required
      - `id`: string, required
      - `name`: string | null, required
      - `token`: string, required — The feed's URL secret — only ever returned to its owner
      - `statuses`: array of string, required
      - `lastAccessedAt`: string | null, required — ISO 8601.
      - `createdAt`: string, required — ISO 8601.
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `404` — The resource does not exist
  - `Error`

### DELETE /api/v1/calendar-feeds/{feedId}

Revoke a calendar feed

Members revoke their own feeds; anyone holding `calendarFeed:manageAny` (owner/admin) can revoke any feed in the workspace. After this the token 404s.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `feedId` | string | yes |  |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organizationId` | string | yes |  |

**Responses**

- `200` — The mutation was applied
  - `CalendarFeedDeleteResult`
    - `ok`: literal `true`, required
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `404` — The resource does not exist
  - `Error`

### GET /api/v1/calendar/{token}

Public iCal feed

The iCalendar (.ics) feed behind a calendar-feed subscription. The token is the only credential — no session or API key — so calendar clients can poll it anonymously. A `.ics` suffix on the token is accepted and ignored.

**Auth:** None (signature-verified or public)

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `token` | string | yes |  |

**Responses**

- `200` — The feed's events as an iCalendar document
- `404` — The resource does not exist
  - `Error`
